name: @argszero/dsh-cancel-cause-guard
description: A plugin that keeps one abusive cancellation from making a whole conversation view unreadable. ReactLoopAgent.cancel hands its argument to AbortController.abort(), so it becomes signal.reason; the turn's catch reads it back through abortedCancelCause, whose switch ends in assertNever *inside the catch body*, so turnEnds stays at its null initializer and the unconditional finally appends turn/end with that null (agent-loop/src/agent.ts:385 — the non-null assertion on that line is what makes it compile). Nothing on the write path refuses it: the append-time validator inspects surface slots, request/header and tool/result, and turn/end.reason is a TypeScript-only invariant. Every reader that dereferences it then throws, and the chat view does exactly that while rendering (ui-chat/src/client/contract/turn-process.ts:72), so one such row blanks the conversation area for every session, newly created ones included. Reported four times (#8832, #9156, #9646, #9699). This plugin closes the defect at two depths. At the entry: it listens to agent/created — the serial, awaited lifecycle edge that hands over the live agent instance (packages/core/agent/src/index.ts:550) — and shadows that instance's cancel with a wrapper that carries anything outside the union as { kind: 'hook', reason } before the loop ever sees it; hook is the member the union reserves for plugins, so the rewrite is not a lie, and one property write covers every instance-level caller because ReactLoopAgent.cancel is a prototype method and the shadow is an own property. At the write: the same edge hands over the live session, and the plugin shadows that session's append too, so a turn/end row whose reason no reader can dereference is committed as { kind: 'aborted', reason: { kind: 'hook', reason: <text> } } instead — the arm that covers a caller which reaches the class rather than the instance, or an instance that refuses the own cancel property. Every rewrite and every repaired row is logged with the offending value rendered as JSON, so the producer can be found and fixed rather than tolerated. It never refuses a cancellation, forwards an already-valid cause by reference, leaves any reason a reader can dereference untouched (a plugin's own TurnEndReasonMap variant included), and cannot repair rows already on disk. Zero runtime dependencies beyond the harness packages it declares.
